sql: SELECT "br_id", date('now') AS cur_date FROM "brs" LIMIT 5

SELECT "br_id", COALESCE("br_nm", "br_id", 'Default') AS coal FROM "brs" LIMIT 5
SELECT "br_id", REPLACE(CAST("br_id" AS TEXT), '1', 'One') AS rep FROM "brs" LIMIT 5
SELECT "br_id", SUBSTR(CAST("br_id" AS TEXT), 1, 3) AS sub, INSTR(CAST("br_id" AS TEXT), '1') AS pos FROM "brs" LIMIT 5
SELECT "br_id", printf('ID-%s', "br_id") AS formatted FROM "brs" LIMIT 5
SELECT group_concat("br_id", '; ') AS all_ids FROM (SELECT "br_id" FROM "brs" LIMIT 5)
SELECT "br_id", CAST("br_id" AS REAL) AS real_val, CAST("br_id" AS INTEGER) AS int_val FROM "brs" LIMIT 5
SELECT "br_id", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "br_id") AS rnk FROM "brs" LIMIT 5
